title: AWS and TMU AIMLA Collaboration
content: TMU AIMLA has announced a collaboration event with Amazon Web Services focused on the intersection of AWS technology and artificial intelligence or machine learning. The event date and location are still to be announced, and registration is not currently open.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Events component

title: Code Blitz
content: Code Blitz is a coding competition organized for TMU Tech Week. It is intended for TMU students, but students from outside Toronto Metropolitan University are also welcome. The source lists the event for February 17 at 6:00 PM in ENG101. Registration is listed as open.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Events component

title: MCU x AIMLA Personal J.A.R.V.I.S.
content: MCU and TMU AIMLA have announced a Personal J.A.R.V.I.S. event about building or exploring a personal artificial intelligence assistant inspired by Iron Man's JARVIS. The source lists the event for March 9 at 6:00 PM, with the location still to be announced. Registration is not currently open.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Events component

title: Q&A and Networking Event
content: TMU AIMLA held a Q&A and networking event on November 19, 2025. The event connected TMU students with industry professionals and student leaders for open discussion, career insights, networking, and community building.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Events component

title: TMU AIMLA Kickoff Event
content: TMU AIMLA held its kickoff event on March 20, 2025. The event marked the start of the term and brought together students interested in artificial intelligence and machine learning to connect, learn, and build community.

metadata.source: Official TMU AIMLA website Events component

title: Compile and Conquer
content: Compile and Conquer was held on March 26, 2026. The event was described by TMU AIMLA as a large collaboration involving computing student organizations at Toronto Metropolitan University.
